title: Sort, Filter, Reduce a Roster
hints:
`std::find_if` returns an iterator to the first match, or `v.end()` if there is none. Turn the iterator into a pointer with `&*it` so the caller gets the address of the element inside `v`, not a copy.

```cpp
auto it = std::find_if(v.begin(), v.end(),
    [&](const Student& s) { return s.name == name; });
return it == v.end() ? nullptr : &*it;
```

For `names_above`, a plain range-for with `if (s.score > min_score) out.push_back(s.name);` is the idiomatic answer.
